product_summary: Website lachemi.com (Pune, Maharashtra) shows two divisions: (1) Azo Polymerization Initiators - substituted azonitrile free-radical initiators for PVC, acrylonitrile, styrene, acrylic, vinyl acetate, MMA polymerization, cross-linking, blowing agents, coatings; (2) Personal Care Ingredients - La'PHEN / La'NATURA preservative blends (sodium benzoate, potassium sorbate, dehydroacetic acid, benzoic acid, phenoxyethanol, ethylhexylglycerine, benzyl alcohol, glucono delta lactone), La'ACT functional actives (anti-acne, anti-dandruff, oral care, deodorant, intimate hygiene, anti-fungal - positioned as Triclosan/climbazole alternatives), natural emulsifiers & emollients, and cosmetic butters (shea, kokum, mango, cocoa). Declared code 293321 = hydantoin and its derivatives (e.g. DMDM hydantoin / imidazolidine-2,4-dione) - a preservative chemistry that does NOT appear anywhere in the published portfolio.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - site claims 'Manufacturing In-house Capabilities' and 'R&D Technical Expertise' (lachemi.com/about-us), but no plant address, capacity, GMP/ISO certificate numbers or product-wise COA/TDS are published; cosmetic butters (shea/kokum/mango/cocoa) are clearly traded/bought-in commodities, so a mixed manufacturer+trader model is most likely.
comment: HS mismatch, company retained per Rule 3 - verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Declared 293321 (hydantoin derivatives) is not corroborated by any product on the company's own catalogue; the real core is azo/azonitrile initiators (Ch. 2927) plus benzoate/phenoxyethanol/dehydroacetate preservative blends (Ch. 2918/2909/3824) and vegetable butters (Ch. 1515/1516/1804). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a partial misclassification: the company is specialty/organic fine chemicals for polymers and cosmetics, not oil & gas. Trader signs: butter line and blended preservative systems are almost certainly resold; no manufacturing site or certification details published. All product lines are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, invoice or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope), so nothing here is corroborated by a customs entry. Note: the input name is garbled ('PRIYATE' for 'PRIVATE') and the claimed PAN/state were not verified - registry checks are outside this role. Recommended corrected HS-6 for the primary line: 2927.00 (azo initiators), with 3824.99 for preservative blends.
